# Fixture motion contract

Status: target design; implementation and verification pending.

## Contract references

```json motion-contract
{
  "schema": 1,
  "target": "motion-v2",
  "migration": "legacy",
  "parts": {
    "root": [
      "fixture#Fixture"
    ],
    "rule": [
      "separator#Separator"
    ]
  }
}
```

## Capability ownership

| Capability | Coverage and owner | References |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Appearance | Default: independently inserted fixture paint; parent presence consumes the same cause. | default: `fixture.root.enter` |
| Size | Default: fixture shell owns content-driven bounded size, excluding passive layout. | default: `fixture.root.resize` |
| Surface colour | Default: fixture background; inherited Separator rule has its own surface writer. | default: `fixture.root.colour`; inherited: `fixture.rule.colour` |
| Text colour | Default: fixture foreground only; the separator has no text. | default: `fixture.root.colour` |
| Changed text | Default for the owned string; rich content stays explicitly composed. | default: `fixture.root.replace`; composed: `@root` |
| Changed numbers | Not applicable: this fixture displays an identity string, never a numeric quantity. | not-applicable: `@root` |

## Choreography and modes

| Trigger / owner | Full | Reduced | None | Binding → preset → recipe/form |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Insert / fixture root | Opacity entry from current semantic paint. | Short opacity. | Final visibility immediately. | `fixture.root.enter` → `presence.inline` → `data.transition/opacity` |
| Content / fixture shell | Clamped natural size continuity. | Final size immediately. | Final size immediately. | `fixture.root.resize` → `geometry.compact` → `geometry.resize/measured` |
| State / fixture root | Scoped background and foreground transition. | Short colour feedback. | Final colours immediately. | `fixture.root.colour` → `state.color` → `state.color/surface-foreground` |
| Rule colour / inherited Separator | Separator owns background feedback. | Short colour feedback. | Final colour immediately. | `fixture.rule.colour` → `state.color` → `state.color/surface` |
| Display revision / fixture string | Retain unchanged graphemes and replace changed runs without stagger. | Short changed-run opacity. | Exact final string immediately. | `fixture.root.replace` → `text.replace` → `text.change/changed-runs` |

## Interruption and lifecycle

Retarget the latest committed revision. Close/unmount invalidates completion callbacks; live reduced,
none and zero clocks settle their respective targets and clean up only owned property writers.

## Geometry and performance

Measure natural destination content after commitment; size a separate bounded shell. Native focus
and passive reflow win over decorative geometry. Work is limited to one content transaction.

## Acceptance scenarios

Exercise repeated content changes, parent presence, live mode and zero-clock changes, focused resize
and unmount. These are target scenarios, not runtime evidence supplied by this fixture.
